summary: Temporal rewind was researched, built, and proven in AE.
developmentPattern: Search Tutorial Drive for the closest missing temporal behavior first, then use Adobe documentation to confirm native semantics before proof.
reusableLesson: A real rewind replays source frames backward; effect recovery is not equivalent.

capabilityGap.requestedBehavior: Replay the just-played frames backward before the transition exits.

researchSources.title: How To Make The Smoothest Reverse Edit? | After Effects Tutorial
researchSources.notes: Tutorial-first construction reference for real reverse playback.

tutorialTechnique.what: Replay recently shown source frames backward before the transition exits.
tutorialTechnique.whenWhy: Use when the reference visibly retraces recent motion as a transition accent.
tutorialTechnique.how: Build a bounded descending source-time segment with Time Remap.
tutorialTechnique.access: Requires native time-remap and keyframe control.
tutorialTechnique.proof: Rendered source-time direction must become negative over the measured rewind window.
tutorialTechnique.transfer: Preserve backward replay while adapting span, duration, speed, and exit behavior.

tutorialCompilation.constructionPattern: Use Time Remap keyframes with a descending source-time segment.
tutorialCompilation.adaptationNotes: Adapt source-frame span, duration, speed, and exit behavior to the reference.

triggerConditions: The reference visibly replays source frames that were just shown.
invariants: Source time descends during the rewind phase.
repairStrategies: Re-measure and retime the descending Time Remap keys.
transferCriteria: Preserve negative source-time replay on materially different footage.

researchSources.title: Time-stretching and time-remapping
researchSources.notes: Time Remap can replay a bounded source-frame span backward.

learnedSkill.title: Temporal Rewind / Reverse Playback
learnedSkill.requestedBehavior: Replay the just-played frames backward before the transition exits.
learnedSkill.constructionPattern: Use Time Remap keyframes with a descending source-time segment.
learnedSkill.adaptationNotes: Adapt source-frame span, duration, speed, and exit behavior to the reference.

triggerConditions: The reference visibly replays source frames that were just shown.
invariants: Source time must descend during the rewind phase and the replayed frames must preserve recognizable temporal continuity.
adaptationAxes: Rewind duration, source-frame span, playback rate, interpolation, and exit behavior.
failureSignals: Effect parameters recover while source time continues forward, or the rewind replays the wrong frame span.
repairStrategies: Re-measure the reference source-time trajectory and move the descending Time Remap keys to the observed frame span and duration.
transferCriteria: On different footage, the same temporal invariant survives while duration and frame span are adapted to the new reference.

invariantRules.invariant: Source time must descend during the rewind phase and the replayed frames must preserve recognizable temporal continuity.
